claims.text: Buahan is in the highlands north of Ubud in Payangan, Gianyar, surrounded by tropical forests with views of Bali's seven peaks.

findings.quote: Buahan is located in the lush highlands north of Ubud in Payangan, Gianyar, surrounded by tropical forests and views of Bali's seven peaks.
findings.note: The FAQ states every element of the claim.

claims.text: The resort follows a 'No Walls, No Doors' design philosophy of open-air living spaces and uninterrupted views.

findings.quote: "No Walls, No Doors" is Banyan Tree Escape design philosophy, inviting guests to experience a deeper connection with nature through open-air living spaces, uninterrupted views
findings.note: Confirms the design philosophy, open-air living spaces and uninterrupted views.

claims.text: Each private bale is an interpretation of a traditional Balinese pavilion, positioned to frame a distinct view of the surrounding landscape.

findings.quote: Each private 'bale', our interpretation of a traditional Balinese pavilion, is thoughtfully positioned to frame a distinct view of Buahan's surrounding landscape
findings.note: Matches the claim in full.

claims.text: Every bale has a private pool, open-air living spaces and uninterrupted views of the surrounding landscape.

findings.quote: Each 160-square-metre _bale_ has been thoughtfully designed with a private pool, open-air living spaces, and uninterrupted views of the surrounding landscape.
findings.note: Covers the private pool, open-air living spaces and uninterrupted views.

claims.text: The bales are built from locally sourced and reclaimed materials, including Ulin wood.

findings.quote: each _bale_ has been constructed using locally sourced and reclaimed materials, including resilient Ulin wood given new life within the resort.
findings.note: Covers locally sourced and reclaimed materials, including Ulin wood.

claims.text: The bales have no walls, just curtains for privacy and roll-down bamboo shades for rain.

findings.quote: They have no walls, just breezy curtains for privacy and roll-down bamboo shades in case of rain.
findings.note: Editorial review states every element of the claim.

claims.text: Bathrooms have hand-hammered copper bathtubs and carved wooden mirrors made by Balinese carpenters.

findings.quote: Bathrooms come with double sinks, hand-hammered copper bathtubs, and ornate wooden mirrors (each one unique) carved by Balinese carpenters.
findings.note: Covers both the copper bathtubs and the carved mirrors.

claims.text: Toja Spa is an open-air spa named after the Indonesian word for water.

findings.quote: Toja Spa, meaning "water" in Indonesian, is an open-air spa concept that enhances your connection with nature.
findings.note: Establishes both the open-air concept and the name meaning.

findings.quote: Named after the Indonesian word for water, Toja Spa draws inspiration from one of nature's most restorative elements.
findings.note: Confirms the origin of the name.

claims.text: Toja Spa is spread over open-air bamboo pavilions overlooking the Ayung River.

findings.quote: It’s spread out over a clutch of open-air bamboo pavilions which overlook the Ayung River
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: The outdoor swimming pool has panoramic views of the jungle and nearby mountains.

findings.quote: Offering panoramic views of the jungle and nearby mountains, the pool provides a serene space to relax and immerse yourself in nature
findings.note: Appears in the Outdoor Swimming Pool section.

claims.text: Open Kitchen, the signature restaurant, celebrates locally sourced ingredients, seasonal harvests and Indonesian culinary traditions.

findings.quote: Open Kitchen is Buahan's signature restaurant, celebrating locally sourced ingredients, seasonal harvests, and the richness of Indonesian culinary traditions.
findings.note: Matches the claim.

claims.text: Every stay includes daily breakfast and a daily five-course dinner at Open Kitchen for two guests.

findings.quote: Daily **breakfast** at Open Kitchen for two guests
findings.note: Listed under Included in Every Stay.

findings.quote: Daily five-course **dinner** at Open Kitchen for two guests
findings.note: Listed under Included in Every Stay.

claims.text: The Seven Peaks Pool Bale has panoramic views of Bali's seven peaks emerging with the morning light.

findings.quote: Wake to Buahan's most iconic moments as Bali's seven peaks emerge with the morning light. Framed by panoramic mountain views and open-air living
findings.note: Seven Peaks Pool Bale description.

claims.text: The Above the Waterfall Pool Bale sits above a cascading waterfall, surrounded by rainforest.

findings.quote: Hidden above a cascading waterfall and embraced by lush rainforest, this is Buahan's most secluded bale.
findings.note: Above the Waterfall Pool Bale description.

claims.text: The Soul Freedom Journey is a guided purification ritual at the resort's own waterfall, beginning with making a Canang Sari offering.

findings.quote: Connect with Bali's spiritual traditions through a guided purification ritual at Buahan's waterfall. Beginning with the creation of a Canang Sari offering
findings.note: Covers the guided purification ritual, the waterfall and the Canang Sari offering.

findings.quote: Experience a spiritual purification ritual to cleanse both body and mind, refresh the spirit at the resort's very own waterfall.
findings.note: Confirms the waterfall is the resort's own.

claims.text: On the Sandikala Walk, guests walk through the rice fields at twilight with a local farmer, learn about the Subak irrigation system and watch the fireflies.

findings.quote: walk through the rice fields at twilight with a local farmer, learn about the Subak irrigation system and rice traditions, watch the fireflies
findings.note: Sandikala Walk description.

claims.text: In the open-air bales, guests can expect changing weather, natural sounds and occasional encounters with local wildlife and insects.

findings.quote: Guests can expect changing weather conditions, natural sounds, and occasional encounters with local wildlife and insects that are part of the surrounding environment.
findings.note: FAQ on staying in an open-air bale.

claims.text: The dry season from April to October is ideal for outdoor activities and clear mountain views; November to March is the green season.

findings.quote: The dry season from April to October is ideal for outdoor activities and clear mountain views, while the green season from November to March brings lush landscapes
findings.note: Matches both seasons.

claims.text: Each bale is designed for a maximum of two adults.

findings.quote: Each _bale_ is designed for a maximum of two adults.
findings.note: Matches the claim.
